args.subject: Private dining reservation request for 12 people
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing from Blue Sparrow Tech. I would like to request a private dining table for 12 people next Friday, May 22, 2024.

Could you please let me know your availability and any menu options for a group of our size? We are looking to have a business dinner and would appreciate your assistance in arranging this.

Please feel free to contact me at emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com or by phone at 327-420-4923 if you need any further information.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
